title: Named arterial model relationships
author: NeuroImage teaching workspace
objective: Identify the named source models, trace their supplied extents and compare spatial relationships from several views.

scenes.title: Left Internal carotid artery
scenes.prompt: Trace the source left internal carotid model and compare it with the adjacent cerebral branch models. Identify the selected source object and describe its relationship to the visible context.
scenes.note: Left Internal carotid artery. This view retains the source author's named geometry, object extent and native XYZ coordinates. Source definitions and processing details accompany the model.
